6cc805267e.q: What was the energy independence rate of Namur region that sparked the creation of CEN?
6cc805267e.a: The energy independence of the Namur region was only 3%, including fuel for cars, home heating, and industry, meaning 97% of energy consumption was imported. This discovery during a carpooling discussion among scientists and citizens led Xavier Gillon and others to create CEN as a non-profit organization to promote energy independence.

e2e049b802.q: How did Rue Novation in Namur transition from organizing citizens by street to organizing by neighborhood?
e2e049b802.a: Initially the project aimed to organize renovation by street, but Xavier Gillon realized some streets had only five houses while others had 1,000 houses, making street-level organization impractical. The project then enlarged to neighborhood-based groups, and eventually to city-wide groups of up to 15 citizens. The flexibility to avoid fixing maximal distance proved important for success.

c92ac5ab60.q: What percentage of the 25 Rue Novation participants in Namur had completed their home renovation by the end of the project?
c92ac5ab60.a: Half of the 25 citizens who participated in the two small group schemes had finished complete renovation, with the other half having work either ongoing or to be done within six coming months. Only one or two persons were expected not to finish within that timeframe.

a9f379934a.q: What was CEN's first major project and how did its recommendations influence municipal politics in Namur?
a9f379934a.a: CEN's first main project was organizing a citizen panel on energy independence in 2021, gathering around 40 citizens who formulated recommendations. Several political parties integrated some of these recommendations into their municipality programs for the 2024 elections, demonstrating the project's practical impact on local governance.

2a90ec8ba8.q: Why did Rue Novation in Namur use municipality identity for communications rather than nonprofit partner names?
2a90ec8ba8.a: Xavier Gillon explains that the municipality identity was more well-known and trusted by citizens. Additionally, physical direct contact was emphasized to counter digital renovation scams, and videos featuring real people leading the project were used on social networks to build credibility and provide a human face to the program.
